subject: Renewal: Aequitas Health - pricing & flexible commit options
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Kline <sarah.kline@aequitashealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-10T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Renewal: Aequitas Health - pricing & flexible commit options

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the time last week. As promised, attaching a clean renewal proposal for the 12-month term coming up in Q3. High level:

- Baseline unit price: $0.007/token (current: $0.008) with a 6% guaranteed discount in year 1 vs current list
- One-time onboarding credit: $25,000 to offset integration and additional logging retention for regulated workflows
- Price hold: 9 months guaranteed on listed unit price from contract effective date; automatic review at month 9 if usage > 150% of committed volume
- Commitment flexibility: option to swap up to 20% of committed capacity between embedding and generation units once during term

Attached: Aequitas_Renewal_Proposal_Q3.pdf (proposal, terms)

Would love to get your feedback on whether the price hold + credit addresses your procurement ask, or whether we should surface a deeper one-time concession to get to signature before budget cycle closes on March 1. If it helps, Ben can join a quick call to walk the cost model and burst handling.

Next steps suggested:
- You/Procurement review and flag any legal/ procurement items by Feb 17
- If acceptable, we'll prepare DocuSign and target a Mar 1 signature to preserve Q3 pricing

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0112

--
Attachment: Aequitas_Renewal_Proposal_Q3.pdf (PDF, 2 pages, term summary)

From: Sarah Kline <sarah.kline@aequitashealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-10T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: Aequitas Health - pricing & flexible commit options

Jordan —

Thanks for the proposal and the clear summary. Procurement reviewed and a few immediate notes:

- The 6% discount looks reasonable but our budget owner is asking whether Redwood can extend a 12-month price hold (not 9 months) to match our fiscal planning.
- We need a stronger onboarding credit to cover audit-related logging changes; asking for $50k rather than $25k.
- Our procurement team also requires SOC2 evidence and an updated data retention SLA clause in the contract; I attached our standard procurement form (Aequitas_Procurement_Form.pdf).

I'll loop in our procurement lead if we move toward redlines. We're running up against internal approval gates that close March 1, so time is tight. Is there any flexibility on a deeper near-term concession in exchange for committing to a 12-month term and an auto-renewal clause?

Appreciate it —
Sarah Kline
Director, Data Product
Aequitas Health
sarah.kline@aequitashealth.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-11T09:20:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: Aequitas renewal concession options (need quick decision)

Marissa / Ben / Laura —

Quick summary from Procurement at Aequitas: they want a 12-month price hold (vs our proposed 9), and a $50k onboarding credit to cover audit-related logging changes. They are willing to commit for 12 months and add an auto-renewal provision if we give the concession. They are under a March 1 budget gate.

Options I see:
1) Meet them halfway: extend price hold to 12 months, increase onboarding credit to $35k, keep baseline 6% discount. Requires approval from Sales Credits (Ben) and Finance (Laura) but keeps net margin impact under control.
2) Full concession to accelerate close: 12-month hold + $50k credit + increase discount to 8% in year 1. This would likely push margin below our standard floor but could be justified by expansion potential (they're targeting +30% usage YOY).
3) Trade: offer 8% discount + $35k credit but add a 12-month commit + 12-month auto-renew at pre-agreed CPI cap (2%) to protect list price upside.

Recommendation: Option 3. We protect pricing exposure (CPI cap), give a meaningful discount and partial credit, and get a contractual auto-renew that smooths churn and opens the path for a capacity uptick later this year.

If you agree, I'll propose that to Sarah with a DocuSign link and request SOC2 evidence upload; legal will prepare a short amendment to the SOW for the credit. Need final sign-off by EOD Feb 11 to make the March 1 target.

Thanks,
Jordan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

--
(Internal only)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Kline <sarah.kline@aequitashealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-12T08:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: Aequitas Health - pricing & flexible commit options

Hi Sarah —

Appreciate the clear ask and the procurement form — we've reviewed internally and can move on a compromise that keeps your March 1 timeline intact. Final offer below:

- Baseline unit price: $0.007/token
- Year 1 discount: 8% off our list rate (applies to committed volume)
- One-time onboarding credit: $35,000 applied on signing (to help with logging/audit changes)
- Price hold: 12 months guaranteed from contract effective date (we'll include a CPI cap of 2% on any post-hold adjustments)
- Commit & auto-renew: 12-month committed volume with an automatic 12-month renewal unless either party provides 60-day notice prior to renewal; renewal pricing subject to CPI cap clause
- Condition: We will require SOC2 report upload to our contract portal and a short SOW amendment for the credit (legal to prepare).

If that works, I'll send the DocuSign package and a short amendment for the $35k credit today so you can get it into your March 1 approval queue. DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/aeq-renewal-2026 (stub)
